description: This Java interface defines a repository for managing LifecycleEvent entities in a SQL database, including methods for querying, filtering, and deleting lifecycle events based on various parameters.
external_methods: Page<LifecycleEventEntity> findEvents(UUID, UUID, Long, Long, Pageable)

classes.name: LifecycleEventRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for LifecycleEventEntity, providing custom query methods for event retrieval and deletion.

methods.name: findLatestEvents
methods.description: Retrieves the latest lifecycle events for a specific tenant and entity, limited by a specified number.

methods.name: findEvents
methods.description: Fetches paginated lifecycle events filtered by tenant, entity, and optional time range.

methods.name: findEvents (overloaded)
methods.description: Fetches paginated lifecycle events with additional filters such as service ID, event type, success status, and error message.

methods.name: removeEvents
methods.description: Deletes lifecycle events for a specific tenant and entity within an optional time range.

methods.name: removeEvents (overloaded)
methods.description: Deletes lifecycle events with additional filters including service ID, event type, success status, and error message.
